subsystems.name: Bioreactor vessels
subsystems.role: provide a controlled, sterile environment where engineered microbes grow and produce the target molecule.
parts: agitators and spargers for mixing and oxygen

subsystems.name: Engineered microorganisms
subsystems.role: the production factories — yeast or bacteria modified to synthesise specific proteins or chemical precursors.

subsystems.name: Media and feedstock preparation
subsystems.role: supply sugars, nitrogen, vitamins and minerals in a sterile form.

subsystems.name: Downstream processing
subsystems.role: separate the target product from cells and media, then purify it to food or material grade.

subsystems.name: Process control and automation
subsystems.role: keep fermentation conditions stable and monitor yield in real time.
parts: sensors for pH, dissolved oxygen, temperature and pressure
control software and programmable logic controllers

subsystems.name: Utilities and waste handling
subsystems.role: provide cooling, heating, clean steam and safe disposal of spent media.

buildSteps.title: Design the urban facility
buildSteps.detail: Choose a site near city consumers with access to water, power, sugar feedstock and waste routes. Design containment, ventilation and waste treatment to meet local regulations.

buildSteps.title: Engineer the production strain
buildSteps.detail: Modify yeast or bacteria using synthetic biology tools to express the desired protein or molecule. Validate yield and stability at lab scale before scaling up.

buildSteps.title: Build the bioreactor suite
buildSteps.detail: Install stainless steel bioreactors of the chosen scale, with agitation, aeration, sterile sampling and sensors for pH, temperature and dissolved oxygen.

buildSteps.title: Set up media preparation
buildSteps.detail: Install sterilisation and mixing equipment to prepare nutrient media from sugars, nitrogen sources and micronutrients, then feed it sterilely to the reactors.

buildSteps.title: Install downstream processing
buildSteps.detail: Set up centrifuges, filtration and chromatography to separate the product from cells and media, followed by drying or formulation.

buildSteps.title: Integrate process control
buildSteps.detail: Connect all sensors and valves to a control system that maintains temperature, pH and oxygen levels, and logs data for batch release.

buildSteps.title: Commission and validate
buildSteps.detail: Run test batches to prove sterility, yield and product quality. Obtain food-safety or material-safety approvals before selling anything.

buildSteps.title: Scale up and operate
buildSteps.detail: Gradually increase batch size and frequency, optimise energy and water use, and establish local distribution for the products.

prerequisites.why: large-scale fermentation is already used to make enzymes, insulin and some food proteins.
needed to engineer microbes that produce high yields of a specific target molecule.
purifying commodity proteins cheaply enough to compete with conventional farming is still difficult.

prerequisites.tech: Urban infrastructure for feedstock and waste
prerequisites.why: cities must reliably supply clean sugars and dispose of nutrient-rich wastewater.
rules for precision-fermented proteins vary by country and can delay commercial launch.

pathway.milestone: lab-scale production of high-value proteins such as heme, dairy and egg proteins
pathway.unlocks: proof that engineered microbes can make familiar foods and ingredients.

pathway.milestone: pilot-scale urban bioreactors making specialty proteins for local niche markets
pathway.unlocks: real-world data on cost, energy use and consumer acceptance.

pathway.milestone: commercial urban farms producing commodity proteins at prices competitive with farming
pathway.unlocks: resilient local food supply chains and lower land and water use.

pathway.milestone: integrated molecular farms also making materials and chemical precursors
pathway.unlocks: circular urban economies where waste becomes feedstock.
